insights.headline: Cargo grew 3.9% a year. Income grew 11%.
insights.body: In FY17 the port earned Rs 150 for every tonne. By FY25 it earned Rs 256. Prices, cargo mix and land rent did more than volume.

insights.headline: Oil is now three tonnes in every ten.
insights.body: Petroleum went from 21.8% to 30.1% of cargo in two years. HPCL's Visakh refinery throughput rose from 8.41 to 15.31 MMT between FY22 and FY25, close to the rise in the port's crude and fuel imports. A strong match, not proof of one customer.

insights.headline: Rail's share fell from 46% to 35%.
insights.body: Part of this is arithmetic: crude oil travels by pipe. Part is less iron ore and other cargo arriving by train.

insights.headline: 0.71 hours, or 5.01?
insights.body: Waiting time often counts only delay charged to the port. Counting every cause, ships waited about five hours in April to September 2025.

insights.headline: Top 20 for containers in 2023. Ranked 104th in 2025.
insights.body: On the World Bank's current series the score went from 115 to 46 to 23. The 2023 headline was real. It is also out of date.

audit.title: What India's auditor found in FY25

items.finding: Rs 237.97 crore of Rs 420.00 crore in dues was over five years old. Similar comments were made every year from FY20.
Internal controls were described as not adequate. The audit raised 67 findings; VPA corrected 40 in the accounts.
Confirmation for Rs 572.31 crore of pension-fund annuities was not produced.
The gratuity fund was short by Rs 75.93 crore. In FY21 the auditor put the pension and gratuity gap at Rs 853.28 crore.

audit.reply: VPA's published replies include waiting for a Ministry policy on doubtful debts and staff shortages. Audit comments are findings, not proof of wrongdoing.

whatIf.title: Run the port's numbers
whatIf.warning: A teaching model, not a forecast. It applies one average income per tonne to every cargo because income by commodity is not published in this form.
whatIf.formula: income = estateIncome + sum(cargo * (1 + change)) * 223.74 / 10; cost = 801.73 * (1 - v + v * newTonnes / 82.62); surplus = income - cost
